# netbox_device_front_port (Data Source)

A device front port (dcim.frontport): a pass-through port on the front of a patch panel or cassette, mapped position by position onto rear ports of the same device.

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/frontport/):

> Front ports are pass-through ports which represent physical cable connections that comprise part of a longer path. For example, the ports on the front face of a UTP patch panel would be modeled in NetBox as front ports. Each port is assigned a physical type, and must be mapped to a specific rear port on the same device. A single rear port may be mapped to multiple front ports, using numeric positions to annotate the specific alignment of each.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_front_port" "test" {
  name = "test-device_front_port"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `type` (String) Port type as its NetBox slug, e.g. 8p8c, lc, mpo (any of NetBox's port type choices).

### Read-Only

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000).
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected.
- `module_id` (Number) Id of the installed module this component belongs to.
- `positions` (Number) Number of positions on the front port, at least the number of rear_ports mappings. NetBox checks a lower value against the mappings it already holds, so remove mappings in one apply and lower positions in the next.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Rear port of a single-position front port: the same as rear_ports = [{position = 1, rear_port_id = ..., rear_port_position = ...}]. Conflicts with rear_ports and with positions > 1.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on rear_port_id. Requires rear_port_id.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes Set) Mappings of the front port's positions onto rear ports of the same device, one object per position. Derived from rear_port_id and rear_port_position when those are set; an empty set, or neither form, leaves the port unmapped. Changing the set recreates every mapping, since NetBox 4.6 rejects an update that resends an existing one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rear_ports))
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rear_ports`

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) Position on the front port, 1-based and unique per port.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Id of the rear port the position maps to.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on that rear port, 1-based; each rear port position takes one mapping.
